subject: Communication
title: EQ in Relationships: Gottman's Discoveries
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: EQ in Relationships: Gottman's Discoveries.

hook.text: John Gottman can predict divorce with 93% accuracy — by watching a couple argue for just 15 minutes.

buildup.text: His 'Four Horsemen' — criticism, contempt, defensiveness, and stonewalling — are the communication patterns that predict divorce.

discovery.text: Contempt — expressing superiority and disgust — is the single strongest predictor of relationship failure.

twist.text: The antidote isn't grand gestures. It's small moments of 'turning toward' your partner's bids for emotional connection.

climax.text: Happy couples have a 5:1 ratio of positive to negative interactions. Unhappy ones dip below 1:1.

punchline.text: Love doesn't die from big betrayals. It dies from small moments of turning away.

quiz.question: What is the strongest predictor of relationship failure according to Gottman?
